# relay_connection (Resource)

A database connection reached through a Relay agent. Upstream TLS is always on; only its CA can be configured.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "relay_connection" "orders" {
  workspace_id      = relay_workspace.prod.id
  name              = "orders"
  engine            = "postgres"
  host              = "orders.internal:5432"
  agent_pool        = "default"
  user              = "app"
  database          = "orders"
  credential_ref    = "secret/data/orders#password"
  credential_source = "vault-prod"

  redact_enabled = true
  redact_rules = [
    { column_pattern = "email", strategy = "hash" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_pool` (String) The agent (pool) that serves this connection, for example `default`, the workspace's managed agent.
- `engine` (String) Database engine, for example `postgres` or `mongodb`.
- `host` (String) Upstream `host:port`. The API does not return it for a connection with `managed_database_id`, so Terraform keeps the configured value, and an import leaves it empty until the next apply.
- `name` (String) Name, unique in the workspace. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace the connection belongs to.

### Optional

- `audit_enabled` (Boolean) Record queries in the audit log.
- `credential_ref` (String) Reference the agent resolves to a credential. Takes precedence over `password`.
- `credential_source` (String) Name of the external secret source that resolves `credential_ref`. Empty uses the agent's built-in source.
- `database` (String) Default database name.
- `host_tls_ca` (String) CA bundle used to verify the upstream server, PEM.
- `listen` (String) Local listen address on the agent.
- `managed_by` (String) Owner tag the dashboard shows. Defaults to `terraform`; set it to another tool or an empty string.
- `managed_database_id` (String) Managed database this connection belongs to.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Upstream password. Write-only on the API: changes made outside Terraform are not detected. Prefer `credential_ref`.
- `policy_fail_mode` (String) What the query firewall does with a query it cannot parse. Empty means `closed`.
- `redact_enabled` (Boolean) Apply `redact_rules` to query results.
- `redact_rules` (Attributes List) Column masking rules. Removing the attribute clears them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--redact_rules))
- `tls_ca` (String) CA bundle for the client certificate, PEM.
- `tls_cert` (String) Client certificate, PEM.
- `tls_key` (String, Sensitive) Client key, PEM.
- `user` (String) Upstream user.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Connection ID.
- `password_set` (Boolean) Whether a password is stored.
- `status` (String) `healthy`, `error` or `unknown`, as last reported by the agent.
- `status_error` (String) Last error reported by the agent.

<a id="nestedatt--redact_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `redact_rules`

Required:

- `column_pattern` (String) Column name or glob.
- `strategy` (String) Masking strategy.

Optional:

- `partial_show` (Number) Characters left visible by partial strategies.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import relay_connection.orders <workspace_id>/<name>
```
